purpose: Record pre-OOS protocol remediation requirements found during the Phase 5C v1 architecture/data preflight. This is not executable and does not replace v1.
preflight_blockers: Separate architecture review required by v1 has no recorded approval.
Real feature and sequence path does not enforce exact one-minute cadence across sparse archive gaps.
A1/A2 architecture and training details are underspecified for exact reproduction.
Walk-forward windows, feature ablations, shuffled-label control, class-imbalance treatment, calibration bins, abstention thresholds, and time-series uncertainty method are not frozen in v1.
A comparable multiclass logistic/statistical baseline is not specified in v1.

decisions_required_before_freeze.separate_architecture_review: REQUIRED; independent written approval must be recorded before OOS scoring.
decisions_required_before_freeze.gap_and_sequence_eligibility: Define and test exact timestamp cadence, maximum permissible gaps, contract/session boundaries, and reason-coded exclusions on the real archive.
decisions_required_before_freeze.walk_forward_windows: PRE_REGISTER_EXPLICIT_DATES_AND_PURGE_EMBARGO; do not infer from Phase 5A without review.
decisions_required_before_freeze.feature_ablations: PRE_REGISTER_EXACT_FAMILIES_AND_ORDER; do not mine features post hoc.
decisions_required_before_freeze.shuffled_label_control: PRE_REGISTER_SEED, permutation unit, which split is shuffled, and fail/stop threshold.
decisions_required_before_freeze.additional_statistical_baseline: DECIDE_Whether a multiclass logistic comparator is required; if yes, freeze regularization, optimizer, stopping, and probability output protocol.
